entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term agent memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients are available, along with support for multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes agent context as browsable files and directories. Its L0, L1, and L2 loading tiers and scoped search and retrieval make it a distinct option for working with context at different levels.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds persistent, connected memory from documents, code, and conversations using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It also supports local text processing without an LLM and provides a CLI for remembering and recalling text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts facts and handles updates, contradictions, and forgetting. Its connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and it also offers plugins, an MCP server, and JavaScript and Python API clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It can share memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It supports managed, local, and self-hosted deployments and includes Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git-like context tree, with version control for committing, branching, and merging context. Its five-tier retrieval includes four non-LLM tiers, and it offers an interactive TUI and REPL, support for 20 LLM providers, and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents that describes itself as zero-dependency and uses one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; its README reports BEAM results for v3.0.0 and notes that LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories, reconciles conflicting information, and briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It also supports importing and exporting memory through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that includes vector search and structured facts. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy is designed to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness that runs tasks against evaluations. It keeps useful lessons, discards dead ends, and leaves traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with the stated goal of never losing a message. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from stored context.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu searches months of indexed session history across supported coding agents, using one shared index. Its terminal tools support both searching past sessions and continuing them.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through a self-hosted Honcho backend. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first layer for agent identity, memory, and secrets, with portable state across multiple agent harnesses. It can import files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memories and their sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, using an open format for multi-agent systems. It offers local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback; its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory keeps long-term memory locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including text and multimodal contexts. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with Hermes Agent and several inference servers.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin provides explainable retrieval: each recall result includes a why_retrieved reason. Its features also include memory canonicalization and contradiction tracking, and it uses an embedded backend by default with an HTTP option.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI maintains a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history as persistent knowledge across sessions. It is designed to help agents proactively recall and evolve memory without embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn stores durable, cross-project memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to coding agents.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-QMD anticipates context needs by watching agent session logs and prefetching context into a cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack combines Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace under a single memory owner, using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management. It prepares a purpose-built evidence packet for the agent on each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep builds reflective memory with semantic search that combines BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link stored notes bidirectionally.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates through middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals; integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and an audit trace of prefetch operations in trace.jsonl. It supports immediate event deletion, rather than retaining persistent summaries after deletion.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers the original goal of a long Claude Code or Codex session from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The XMemo memory provider injects a bounded, ranked context pack before turns and provides tools to search, retrieve, list, and save memories. It uses a local SQLite reliability layer for cache and outbox.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for searching and manually storing memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, with slash commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, and includes repository sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution and combines HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory tools for Hermes Agent, including 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can automatically checkpoint context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory curation loop that works with Markdown and produces reviewable JSON diffs without a database. Its “rot” and “lint” curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert memory changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers is a composable skills framework paired with a software development workflow that moves from specification and design sign-off through planning and subagent execution. It belongs here for its explicit workflow guidance and documented installation across multiple agent harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system that includes skills, templates, design systems, and plugins. It supports multiple coding agents through skills, a CLI, MCP, or runtime adapters, including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides structured cybersecurity skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its broad framework coverage and compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms make it a security-focused option for agent skills.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and it also offers the diagramctl CLI with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court combines a master router and connector skills with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds verification and dispute resolution for agent-to-agent commerce workflows.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid-ai-writing scores files or piped text for detectable AI writing patterns and can rewrite content in up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing mode refuses to modify source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to deduplicate and improve skills, while unifying skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. It integrates with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, with compatibility for Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plugins.org specifications. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This project offers professional agent skills for tasks such as writing PRDs and postmortems, running natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. Its installer copies selected skill files into a tool's config folder, and the project is MIT-licensed.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube skills cover transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other supported agents. The project also requires a TranscriptAPI key, with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory detects reusable patterns in active workflows and proposes them as skills. It can generate SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, and provides slash commands to manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-Hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks, with pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside an account of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, including remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These pre-built Hermes Agent skills turn rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates work with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files with a tangler. It also syncs source edits back into the literate document, keeping code and documentation connected across agents.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running AI agents, storing coordination data in each repository’s shared Git root. It supports supervised teams with defined roles and work states, alongside plugins, recipes, and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Icarus provides cross-instance shared memory through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This Brazilian Hermes Agent community project provides Portuguese-language skills in SKILL.md format, along with installation, configuration, and usage guides. It welcomes contributions through forks and pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This collection provides prompting skills for FLUX image and video generation, plus BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It also includes a FLUX 3 video suite with eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, with installation available through npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. Its README describes the contents as community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Skill Forge turns repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agent instructions that comply with agentskills.io. It offers automated and step-by-step workflows, plus skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language for AI that checks workflows before calling a model and lets users choose the model. It also verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python client and CLI. It supports installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a path to recover from execution problems.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Browse, search, and install community skills through a hub built around the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. Its federated search integrates GitHub and Hugging Face, and it operates autonomously 24/7 via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Find relevant skills with a five-layer retrieval system that includes hard triggers, full-text search, synonyms, and semantic embeddings. By narrowing skill lists before LLM calls, it reduces token usage and can gracefully degrade when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: A personal execution OS with agent-driven scheduling and system design through an MCP connection. It stores data in a single local SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Run adversarial, read-only code reviews using parallel subagents focused on edge cases, adversarial review, and integration analysis. A deterministic pre-scan uses tools including Semgrep, Bandit, ESLint, Gosec, and Ruff, while proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox verifies findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Simplify code with parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents, supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. Its tiered application process includes an approval gate before changes are applied.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Set up a cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent with 2,077 total skills across multiple repositories and 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, CVSS, EPSS, OWASP, NIST, Sigma, and YARA.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Adapt verified procedures for task decomposition, investigation, and evidence-based verification. The skill requires evidence gates for multi-story tasks, provides a protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, and includes a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Implement agentskills.io in C# and .NET with progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Monitor Hermes Agent locally with a real-time dashboard for token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It provides read-only data access with local log desensitization, plus optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: Use plain Markdown skills for code review, session management, and other workflows across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs, using VHS tape files or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries, and optimizes GIFs for target sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, then provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill builds Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field changes.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop fetches sessions, indexes installed skills, and drafts structured improvement proposals. Proposals are review-only by default, with an evaluation gate that supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using the path syntax for Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL. They also select and verify existing project-compatible Python interpreters across those environments.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentskills.io-compliant clients. It also includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection includes tools to transcribe Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, remove common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extract structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its listed uses also include an e-commerce material studio.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents find open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review; the winning wallet is paid 85% automatically. It also supports creating a bounty board and provides public wallet earnings records.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses through Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests agent skills in isolated Docker containers for structure, functionality, and security. It produces Ed25519-signed certificates and provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools. The project also includes five ready-to-use workflow skills and lists support for Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline provides risk checks for token honeypots, taxes, and liquidity, along with market data including DEX slippage and funding rates. It offers REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings across geographic scales, from global coverage to street-level updates. It incorporates user interests through semantic memory to expand searches, and its reports include key conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an MCP endpoint for Western and Vedic astrology with deterministic results and SHA-256 hashes for verification. It requires no authentication and supports per-call REST payments through x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This project provides a progressive MCP client that discovers server metadata and tool schemas incrementally. Its three-layer lazy loading is designed to minimize token usage, while a socket-based daemon maintains persistent connections.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools with Nix, including Hermes, and provides a `nix run` command for listed tools. Its packages are updated automatically each day, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide runs Hermes Agent on Android using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell command execution, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart offers direct or operator-ready CRD-based workflows for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It includes single-writer state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging, and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and offers configurable security policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, alert rules, and access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment, with declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills, and integrates secrets through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for running multiple Hermes Agent instances from one web application, with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular policies for tools, paths, and network access.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use, including Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation available from an OCI registry or a GitHub Pages Helm repository. Optional Copilot and Codex device-login bootstrap and CI testing on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a Kubernetes-focused deployment option.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a multi-agent framework for financial trading research, with analysts covering fundamentals, sentiment, news, and technical signals. It is intended for research, not trading advice.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides self-hosted orchestration for assigning tasks, registering agents, browsing memory, and tracking costs. It offers Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires is a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and several other agents. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces; its web dashboard includes terminal access and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture includes a task bus for delegation and handoffs, plus skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw helps build autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts show how work is delegated across agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a Mission Control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It tracks tasks and review queues on a Kanban board, streams agent reasoning and tool execution, and requires human verification of agent-proposed completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A Master Orchestrator routes and coordinates work through a strict pipeline architecture.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration among agents built on Hermes Agent profiles, MCP, ACP, and Hermes Kanban. Leader and Specialist agents manage task lifecycles, while a real-time Web UI shows agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It coordinates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator stages a competition between two AI companies, orchestrating nine autonomous agents for task execution and learning with Paperclip and Hermes Agent. Its real-time dashboard visualizes agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel runs a local Mixture-of-Agents stack that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their responses, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and described as having no cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project graph with `codegraph init`, using structural extraction and cross-file resolution across supported languages. Its MCP support makes that pre-indexed code knowledge available to Hermes Agent and other coding agents.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Gemini. It pairs a terminal interface with a visualization dashboard and lets users submit usage data to a leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap provides a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It can compare adjacent requests to show context changes and redacts common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools, reading Hermes Agent state alongside other CLIs. It also shows historical trends and usage breakdowns, with sync across multiple devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers, and is compatible with AI providers that support markdown or general prompting. Its integrations include Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents covering roles across the product lifecycle.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins customizes the Hermes terminal UI with community themes, including changes to banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners. YAML-based configuration supports theme creation, with examples ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, with HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, human-readable @handle identity registration, and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, running natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for CLI workflows, with claimed token savings of 90–99%. It includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes agents, with per-folder configuration and skills. It supports switching between default and scoped agents and keeping memories, tools, and custom instructions local to a project.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This project automates installation of Hermes Agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers OpenClaw files such as SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco is a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations and monitors multi-agent systems. Its two monitoring modes include passive analysis and scheduled active probing, while config-aware baselines track performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes Voice adds voice interaction with wake-word support and runs offline without API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes Startup is a local runtime for pursuing online opportunities, operating in deterministic zero-network mode by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin provides semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It includes tools to search, add, and delete memories, as well as a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, available on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It includes a built-in agent with file access, web search, and MCP tools, along with 21 ready-to-use assistants.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI brings Hermes Agent to a web or phone interface, with separate panels for chat, sessions, and workspace files. It also includes profiles, settings, session tools, and themes, and can be accessed remotely through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a companion app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools; the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a Hermes Agent web dashboard for chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It also offers shared and group chats, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, as are npm and Docker options.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace is a web workspace combining chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector panel. It also includes Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser, Monaco, and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: CodeG is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that brings sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other agents together in a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, or delegate tasks with @ and queue work to run in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This Hermes desktop workspace connects directly to local or SSH hosts and presents native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal provides direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first desktop app for Hermes Agent that also supports macOS, with native window and process management. It includes a Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, plus interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, Hermes Cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It can capture page context and selected-tab screenshots, while Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes Agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It is a client-only app for iOS 18 and later; users run the server themselves, and the app is free with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI monitor with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs, and provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs, with search across prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and file paths. It can resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp, and keeps session history on the Mac without telemetry.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel together. It also offers real-time chat with tool-call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It supports one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and includes WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox is for requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need review before those requests proceed.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It adds a kanban board for agentic work and task management, alongside controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally running, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It includes terminal chat with streaming and file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent is a Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that includes 100 tools across 20+ toolsets and supports cloud AI as well as local models through LM Studio. Its workflow engine supports scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted assistant interface with a glassmorphic design for chat and real-time log streaming. It also brings together a file browser, task tracking, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. It supports inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace organized around chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. Its marketplace supports discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, while isolated profiles keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a multi-agent desktop client with streaming chat, model switching, and collaboration orchestrated across 20 specialized AI agents. It also includes a visual Skill Store with 50+ curated one-click installations.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: An unofficial, open-source interactive chat client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, with answers that can include checklists, choices, forms, and rankings. It also lets you approve or deny commands from your phone and runs on Android, web, macOS, and Linux alpha.
